const fs = require('fs')
const assert = require('assert')
const vm = require('vm')
const source = fs.readFileSync('outputs/pages/task-board.mpx', 'utf8')
const script = source.match(/<script setup>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/)[1].replace(/import .* from '@mpxjs\/core'/, '')
const context = { ref: value => ({ value }), computed: getter => ({ get value () { return getter() } }), nextTick: callback => callback(), wx: { getWindowInfo: () => ({ statusBarHeight: 24 }), getMenuButtonBoundingClientRect: () => ({ top: 28, height: 32, width: 88 }) }, assert }

assert.strictEqual(visibleTasks.value.length, 2)
changeFilter('todo')

toggleTask(1)

changeFilter('done')

appendTask()
appendTask()
assert.strictEqual(tasks.value.length, 4)

assert.strictEqual(tasks.value[3].done, false)
refreshTasks()
assert.strictEqual(tasks.value.length, 2)
assert.strictEqual(tasks.value[0].done, false)
assert.strictEqual(refreshing.value, false)
appendTask()
assert.strictEqual(tasks.value[2].id, 3)
changeFilter('all')

assert.strictEqual(pageConfig.renderer, 'skyline')
assert.deepStrictEqual(pageConfig.usingComponents, {})
console.log('PASS: task state transitions, filters, empty state data, refresh reset, unique IDs, config preservation, utilities equality, page JSON parsing.')
